tool.name: BCFTools View Subset (from URL)
tool.description: Subset remote VCF safely (samples and/or regions)

param.name: vcf_url
param.label: VCF URL (http/https/ftp)
param.help: Direct link to a .vcf.gz file accessible from the Galaxy server.

param.name: samples_file
param.label: Sample List (Optional)
param.help: Optional file containing sample IDs to retain. One sample name per line.

param.name: regions_select
param.label: Regions
param.help: Select how to specify genomic regions: type manually, upload a file, or leave empty to process all regions.

param.name: region_string
param.label: Region(s)
param.help: Specify one or more genomic regions. Example: Chr7:1-100 or Chr1:1-100,Chr2:1-100

param.name: regions_file
param.label: Regions File
param.help: Upload a regions file. Can be: tab-delimited (CHROM POS or CHROM BEG END), or BED format (.bed/.bed.gz).

tool.help:
This tool subsets a **remote VCF file** using `bcftools view`. It allows extraction of specific **samples**, **genomic regions**, or both from a compressed VCF file hosted at a URL.
Input ----- - **VCF URL** A direct link to a `.vcf.gz` file accessible from the Galaxy server via HTTP, HTTPS, or FTP.
Sample data: https://3kricegenome.s3.dualstack.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/Nipponbare/snp-only-vcf/01_Nipponbare_IRIS_313-9996.snp.vcf.filtered.gz
- **Sample List (Optional)** A text file containing the names of samples to retain in the output VCF. Each sample ID should appear on a separate line.
Example sample file::
sample1 sample2 sample3
- **Regions (Optional)** Choose how to specify genomic regions to extract:
- **Option 1: No region filtering** - Process the entire VCF file without filtering by region.
- **Option 2: Type regions manually** - Manually specify one or more genomic regions using the format:
**chrom:start-end**
- **Examples:**
- **Single region:** Chr7:1-100
- **Multiple regions (comma-separated):** Chr1:1-100,Chr2:1-100
- This will extract variants from **both regions** in the output VCF.
- **Option 3: Upload regions file** - Upload a regions file instead of typing regions manually.
- **Example**::
Chr1 1 20000 Chr5 50 50000 Chr7 100 100000
Output ------ - **Subset VCF** - A **BGZF-compressed VCF file (.vcf.gz)** containing only the requested subset of variants and samples.
